title.en: A Macro That Finds the Maximum

hints.tr: İkinci kol `let first = $x;` ile başlar; `max_of!($($rest),+)` kendini çağırır.
hints.en: The second arm starts with `let first = $x;`; `max_of!($($rest),+)` calls itself.

tests.code: let mut c = 0; let mut next = || { c += 1; c }; let m = max_of!(next(), next(), next()); assert_eq!(m, 3); assert_eq!(c, 3);
